name: Kimpton EPIC Miami
positioning: Waterfront Kimpton hotel in downtown Miami, above Biscayne Bay (official name Kimpton EPIC Hotel)
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Miami base above Biscayne Bay
Guests traveling with pets of any size

facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Miami, above Biscayne Bay.
The hotel's address is 270 Biscayne Boulevard Way, Miami, FL 33131.
Privai Spa + Fitness offers spa treatments and a fitness center with classes and programs.
Private cabanas are available at the pool area.
Valet parking is available for a daily rate of 58 USD.
Bayfront Park is 0.4 miles from the hotel.
Brightline Miami Station is 1 mile from the hotel.

highlights.text: EPIC Art is a yearlong artist-in-residence program that features local artists.
The hotel hosts weddings, with venues that include the 16th-floor pool terrace and the Metropolis Ballroom.
The hotel welcomes pets of any size, weight or breed at no extra charge.

considerations.text: The hotel does not offer complimentary breakfast.
There is no complimentary local area shuttle.
